Class Resources

java.lang.Object
mesos.client.ui.resource.Resources
public final class Resources extends Object
Classpath PNG loader with a process-wide cache. All MESOS assets sliced from the print PDFs (and the ESERCITAZIONE3/Materials2026 extras) live under /img/.... Returns null if a resource is missing — callers fall back to procedural rendering.

      public static BufferedImage typeIcon(CharacterType type)
      Returns the character-type badge (the coloured token in the card's top-right corner) for type, cropped from a representative card (Era I, copy 0) and cached. Returns null if the card art or the manifest entry is missing — callers fall back to procedural rendering.
